name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 11, 2012
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Susan Haynes, a vestry member of All Saints Episcopal Church
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring September 2012, "National Preparedness Month" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Proclamation declaring October 2012, "Rideshare Month" and October 3, 2012, "Walk & Bike to School Day" in the City of Vista.
P3.
Presentation of Lifesaver Awards to Jien Conde, Maureen Cooper, and Gloria Knapp.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/SA/BSD)
C3.
Treasurer's Cash Report for Month Ending July 31, 2012 (CC)
C4.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review (CC/SA/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the list of designated employees subject to the provisions of the Conflict of Interest Code of the City of Vista pursuant to Chapter 2.32 of the Vista Municipal Code;
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2012- , amending the list of designated employees subject to the provisions of the Conflict of Interest Code; and
3.
Direct the City/District Manager/Executive Director to sign, and the Clerk to file, the 2012 Local Agency Biennial Notices for the City of Vista, Buena Sanitation District, and the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency with the Clerk of the Board of Supervisors.
C5.
County Department of Environmental Health Letter Grading of Mobile Food Facilities (CC)
1.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2012- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California Amending Title 8, by Adding Chapter 8.26 to the Vista Municipal Code Relating to grading of Mobile Food Facilities;" and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2012- , giving notice of intention of the City Council to implement a letter grade system for mobile food facilities, and fixing a date and time of a public hearing for adoption of the ordinance.
C6.
2011-2012 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Annual Performance & Evaluation Report (CC)
C7.
N. Melrose Drive at Highland Drive/W. Los Angeles Drive Traffic Signal Project (CIP 8184) - Award of Construction Contract (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , awarding a construction contract to Tri-Group Construction and Development, Inc. for construction of the N. Melrose Drive at Highland Drive/W. Los Angeles Traffic Signal Project, and authorizing the Mayor to execute the agreement; and (Recommended Action continued on next page)
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2012- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for the 2012/13 Fiscal Year. ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
San Luis Rey Watershed Comprehensive Load Reduction Plan (CC)
1.
Receive a presentation on the San Luis Rey Watershed Total Maximum Daily Load and Comprehensive Load Reduction Plan; and
2.
Approve submittal of the Comprehensive Load Reduction Plan to the San Diego Regional Water Quality Control Board.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
